div.div: طِرَازَدَانٌ , or طِرَازْدَان, or طِرْزَدَان, (accord. to different copies of the Mgh and K,) The case (غِلَاف) of the balance (المِيزَان); an arabicized word; (Mgh, K;) mentioned by Sgh; in Pers. تَرَازُودَانْ [but this is expl. in Pers. dictionaries as meaning the scale of a balance]. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
